description: What it costs to exit a position at a given size, and the largest size that clears a slippage ceiling. Uses an executable venue quote when one exists (basis: quoted) and a constant-product model otherwise (basis: modelled), shows the gap between the two, and returns null rather than zero when an input is unavailable. Returns RYO's public response envelope.

max_slippage_pct.description: Acceptable price impact when exiting, in percent.

participation_pct.description: Share of 24h volume you are willing to be while exiting patiently. Used for the time-to-exit estimate.

size_usd.description: Position size in USD to price an exit for. Omit to receive the ceilings and cost curve without a specific quote.

token.description: Token symbol to assess, e.g. SOL.

name: exit_liquidity
title: Exit liquidity
